corePassives.description: Spectate: Within 3s after Yachiru releases her technique or successfully counters, switch her to the backline to have her Spectate. On-field characters increase their ATK by 20%, while their basic and special attacks grant Ultimate Energy to Yachiru (once per second). Switching Yachiru back in will stop her from Spectating. Inspiration: When Yachiru's Ultimate Energy reaches 50% or 100%, all her teammates gain Inspiration, increasing their Slash DMG by 10% for 6s. Exclusive Seat: When Kenpachi Zaraki is in the team, the bonuses from Spectate and Inspiration on him are increased by 1.5 times.
corePassives.name: Sideline Cheer

corePassives.description: If other characters already have Inspiration when Yachiru releases her Ultimate, its duration resets and Slash DMG increases by 10% for 15s.
